design_philosophy: Function-first, authoritative, and structured. This CRM relies on data legibility, high contrast, and a 'control room' layout to manage leads. No purely decorative gradients. Elements must have clear boundaries.

layout.spacing_scale: Dense and structural (p-4, p-6) for data grids, generous (p-8, p-12) for outer padding.
layout.surfaces: Grid Borders - expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse and 1px solid borders to define data zones. Avoid heavy drop shadows, use flat backgrounds and crisp lines.

components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-[#E4E4E7]), no shadow. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and drop-shadow-sm.

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white rounded-sm hover:bg-[#002078] px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E4E4E7] text-[#0A0A0A] rounded-sm hover:bg-[#F4F4F5] px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

components.tables: Shadcn UI tables, dense padding. Zebra striping or clear 1px borders between rows. Headers must use 'label' typography.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs, rounded-sm, border-[#E4E4E7], focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7] focus:border-transparent.
components.badges: Square or rounded-sm, high contrast text on light tinted backgrounds (e.g., text-[#E63946] bg-[#FEE2E2]).

motion.hover_states: Fast and crisp. Opacity shifts or 1px translation. transition: all 0.15s ease-out.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a subtle slide up (10px, 0.3s ease-out).

assets_and_media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - Use 'regular' or 'bold' weights for clarity in dense data environments.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Manrope' and 'IBM Plex Sans'. Use Manrope for all headings and IBM Plex Sans for tables and body text.
Use strict Shadcn components but override default rounded-md to rounded-sm to maintain a sharp, authoritative 'Swiss' look.
Build the dashboard using a dense 'Control Room' grid layout. Use border-collapse and subtle borders to separate widgets instead of card drop-shadows.
Ensure all data tables (Lead lists, CRM pipelines) are highly readable. Use monospaced font or tabular numerals for CUI, CAEN, and phone numbers.
The UI should feel like an architectural blueprint or a high-end financial terminal: precise, mostly monochrome (black, white, grey), with blue and red used strictly for actions and alerts.
For the Kanban pipeline, use subtle background tints for columns and stark white cards with sharp borders for leads.
Implement language toggle (EN/RO) gracefully in the top nav or sidebar.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='lead-card-123').
